description: Min sends in volume window before bounce rate is scored
Min sends in reply window before reply rate is scored
Min sends in baseline before decay vs own history is scored
Volume usage at or above this scores 0
Volume usage at or below 25% of contract scores 100
Bounce rate at or below 2% scores 0 (industry guidance: keep under 2%)
Bounce rate at or above 5% scores 100 (domain reputation at risk)
Healthy/connected mailboxes at or above 90% scores 0
Healthy/connected mailboxes at or below 50% scores 100
Last 3 days sending at 60%+ of the account's own baseline scores 0
Last 3 days at 10% or less of baseline scores 100 (sending has stopped)
Days since last lead upload: 21 or fewer scores 0
Days since last lead upload: 45 or more scores 100
Reply rate at 80%+ of contracted target scores 0
Reply rate at 20% or less of target scores 100
Reply rate down 25% or less vs own baseline scores 0
Reply rate down 80% or more vs own baseline scores 100
Each additional failing dimension adds 15% of its score to severity
Severity 70+ = critical
Severity 40+ = warning (flagged, goes in the digest)
Severity 20+ = watch
Recent window for detecting sends stopping
Window for volume and bounce rate: common events, react fast
Window for reply rate: replies are rare (2-4%), need more data
Baseline = the 20 sending days before the reply window (about 4 weeks)
First 15 sending days = onboarding: only deliverability scored (mailboxes ramp up, replies lag sends)
Trend compares severity with this many sending days ago
Severity change (points) that counts as worsening/recovering when no issue is active
Move of 10 points in the primary issue's key metric (vs target, contract or baseline) = worsening/recovering
